description: This file defines the MapStringString struct and associated methods for parsing command-line flags representing string-to-string maps, including support for multiple invocations and comma-separated key-value pairs.

classes.name: MapStringString
classes.description: A struct for handling command-line flags that specify a map of string to string, with support for multiple formats and parsing options.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the map as a sorted, comma-separated string of key=value pairs.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Parses a string input to populate the map, supporting multiple key=value pairs separated by commas if NoSplit is false.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type name for flag parsing.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the map is empty.
